sections.Profile:
"The World Series" is an electro-mechanical pinball machine produced by Sankyo Seiki, a Japanese manufacturer, in 1976. This baseball-themed game features two flippers, eight gobble holes, three kick-out holes, and dual outlanes on both sides. The playfield includes an animation unit that simulates base-running, enhancing the baseball experience.

- Manufacturer: Sankyo Seiki
- Years made: 1976
- In production: no
- Type: Electro-Mechanical
- Display: Lights
- Players: 1
- Tags: Single Player, Baseball, Sports, Original Theme, 1970s
